description: English Wikipedia pages for Napoleonic Wars reference notes. Keep this list at battle, campaign, operation, or siege scale.

pages.title: Napoleonic Wars
pages.note: Broad context only. Use specific battles and campaigns for tactical extraction.

pages.title: Battle of Ulm
pages.note: Operational envelopment, rapid corps maneuver, and surrender without major pitched battle.

pages.title: Battle of Austerlitz
pages.note: Deliberate weak flank, central counterstroke, fog, and collapse of allied coordination.

pages.title: Battle of Jena–Auerstedt
pages.note: Twin battles, corps independence, Prussian command failure, and pursuit.

pages.title: Battle of Eylau
pages.note: Winter battle, artillery, cavalry mass charge, and attritional indecision.

pages.title: Battle of Friedland
pages.note: Enemy trapped against river, concentration, artillery, and decisive assault.

pages.title: Battle of Wagram
pages.note: Large-scale artillery, corps coordination, refused pressure, and battlefield exhaustion.

pages.title: French invasion of Russia
pages.note: Strategic depth, scorched earth, logistics failure, attrition, and winter retreat.

pages.title: Battle of Leipzig
pages.note: Coalition pressure, multi-day battle, defection, retreat bottleneck, and operational defeat.

pages.title: Battle of Waterloo
pages.note: Defensive ridge, delayed attacks, coalition timing, cavalry misuse, and arrival of Prussians.
